text.6:55: Thus do We expound the revelations that the way of the unrighteous may be manifest.
text.6:123: And thus have We made in every city great ones of its wicked ones, that they should plot therein. They do but plot against themselves, though they perceive not.
text.6:147: So if they give the lie to thee (Muhammad), say: Your Lord is a Lord of All-Embracing Mercy, and His wrath will never be withdrawn from guilty folk.
text.7:40: Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.
text.7:84: And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!
text.7:133: So We sent against them the flood and the locusts and the vermin and the frogs and the blood - a succession of clear signs. But they were arrogant and became a guilty folk.
text.8:8: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;
text.9:66: Make no excuse. Ye have disbelieved after your (confession of) belief. If We forgive a party of you, a party of you We shall punish because they have been guilty.
text.10:13: We destroyed the generations before you when they did wrong; and their messengers (from Allah) came unto them with clear proofs (of His Sovereignty) but they would not believe. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.
text.10:17: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah and denieth His revelations? Lo! the guilty never are successful.
text.10:50: Say: Have ye thought: When His doom cometh unto you as a raid by night, or in the (busy) day; what is there of it that the guilty ones desire to hasten?
text.10:75: Then, after them, We sent Moses and Aaron unto Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our revelations, but they were arrogant and were a guilty folk.
text.10:82: And Allah will vindicate the Truth by His words, however much the guilty be averse.
text.11:52: And, O my people! Ask forgiveness of your Lord, then turn unto Him repentant; He will cause the sky to rain abundance on you and will add unto you strength to your strength. Turn not away, guilty!
text.11:116: If only there had been among the generations before you men possessing a remnant (of good sense) to warn (their people) from corruption in the earth, as did a few of those whom We saved from them! The wrong-doers followed that by which they were made sapless, and were guilty.
text.12:110: Till, when the messengers despaired and thought that they were denied, then came unto them Our help, and whom We would was saved. And Our wrath cannot be warded from the guilty.
text.14:49: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,
text.15:12: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
text.15:58: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
text.18:49: And the Book is placed, and thou seest the guilty fearful of that which is therein, and they say: What kind of a Book is this that leaveth not a small thing nor a great thing but hath counted it! And they find all that they did confronting them, and thy Lord wrongeth no-one.
text.18:53: And the guilty behold the Fire and know that they are about to fall therein, and they find no way of escape thence.
text.19:86: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
text.20:74: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.
text.20:102: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),
text.25:22: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
text.25:31: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.
text.26:99: It was but the guilty who misled us.
text.26:200: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
text.27:69: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!
text.28:17: He said: My Lord! Forasmuch as Thou hast favoured me, I will nevermore be a supporter of the guilty.
text.28:78: He said: I have been given it only on account of knowledge I possess. Knew he not that Allah had destroyed already of the generations before him men who were mightier than him in strength and greater in respect of following? The guilty are not questioned of their sins.
text.30:12: And in the day when the Hour riseth the unrighteous will despair.
text.30:55: And on the day when the Hour riseth the guilty will vow that they did tarry but an hour - thus were they ever deceived.
text.32:12: Couldst thou but see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord, (and say): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back; we will do right, now we are sure.
text.32:22: And who doth greater wrong than he who is reminded of the revelations of his Lord, then turneth from them. Lo! We shall requite the guilty.
text.34:32: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.
text.36:59: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
text.37:34: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
text.43:74: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
text.44:22: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
text.44:37: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
text.45:31: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.
text.46:25: Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.
text.51:32: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
text.54:47: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
text.55:41: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
text.55:43: This is hell which the guilty deny.
text.68:35: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
text.70:11: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
text.77:18: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
text.77:46: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
